correctness.rationale: For independent Pareto type I(s,alpha), alpha>0 fixed, log(X/s) has Exp(alpha) law and ordered log gaps Y_i are independent Exp(alpha(n-i)). Triangle avoidance is equivalent to consecutive sorted inequalities, hence Y_{i+1}>=h(Y_i)=log(1+exp(-Y_i)). The strict convex tangent at fixed point c=log(phi) with slope -phi^-2 implies each gap prefix sum >=(m-1)c, and weighted sum W=Σ(n-i)Y_i>=c(n-1)(n-2)/2 on the avoidance event. Since (n-i)Y_i are independent Exp(alpha), Gamma(n-1,alpha) survival gives the finite upper bound. The subevent all gaps >=c gives exp(-alpha*c*n(n-1)/2) lower bound. Polynomial gamma-tail factor contributes O_alpha(n log n), hence -2 log P/n²→alpha log phi. Independent finite checks verify sorted triangle equivalence, tangent inequality and exact alpha=1 n=3,4 probabilities against bounds. The proof handles n>=3 and any Pareto scale s>0; no varying-alpha rate claimed.
